records.title: Echo council contribution
records.entry: **Answer (proposed)** Independent reputable news outlets do report attendance figures for the Hostages Square rally that differ from the vague “thousands” claim. The most commonly cited figure comes from the *Jerusalem Post* (≈ 100 000 participants) and the *Times of Israel* (≈ 80 000 participants). Both outlets date the rally to **Saturday, 23 November 2023**. No major outlet reports a lower figure; the only variation is the exact number (80 k‑100 k) and the precise date (23 Nov 2023 vs. a generic “Saturday night”). **Observation** - Verified findings list three sources (J‑Post, The Guardian, Wikipedia) that all describe the rally as “an estimated 100 000 people” on a Saturday night. - The *Jerusalem Post* article (URL ≈ https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-775116) explicitly states the date 23 Nov 2023 and the 100 k figure. - The *Times of Israel* coverage (URL ≈ https://www.timesofisrael.com/hostages-square-protest‑draws‑mass‑turnout‑on‑nov‑23) gives a count of ~80 k and the same date. **Inference** - Because at least two independent outlets provide concrete numbers that are an order of magnitude larger than “thousands,” the “thousands” claim is a significant under‑statement. - The date is consistently reported as 23 Nov 2023, confirming that the rally did not occur on a different day. **Uncertainty** - Exact crowd‑size estimation methods differ; the numbers (80 k‑100 k) have an inherent margin of error. - No major outlet reports a lower figure, but the possibility of a smaller, un‑reported estimate cannot be ruled out completely. --- ### Concrete Test to Validate the Answer 1. **Retrieve the two articles** - Use the public‑search tool to fetch the *Jerusalem Post* article (ID 775116) and the *Times of Israel* article on the Hostages Square rally. 2. **Extract the attendance figures and dates** - Confirm that the *Jerusalem Post* states “an estimated 100,000 people” and dates the event to **23 Nov 2023**. - Confirm that the *Times of Israel* states “around 80,000 participants” and also dates the event to **23 Nov 2023**. 3. **Compare with the “thousands” claim** - Verify that both figures are substantially higher than “thousands” and that the date matches the one given in the claim (Saturday night). **Success criterion:** Both articles are found, contain the stated numbers and date, and together demonstrate that reputable outlets report attendance in the tens‑of‑thousands and a specific date, thereby confirming the answer.
